more_info.overview: Orcein or orchil is a historical natural-colour entry associated with orcein and litmus colouring principles. Its colouring function is to add or restore colour in the food. The available identity record does not establish a typical retail-food example for this exact preparation. Commercial specifications and legal conditions need to refer to the particular substance or preparation named here.
